metadata.name: Enemy Drop Loot V2
metadata.description:
Fork of 赖's Enemy Loot Drop. Credits to baobao2234 for the original code.
Enemies drop items and pickups when killed. Normal enemies, champions and bosses each have separate, fully configurable rates in Mod Config Menu.
Each room has a max on how much it can drop (2 items / 5 pickups in normal rooms, 3 / 8 in big rooms, 5 / 12 in boss rooms), so you can't farm one room by leaving and coming back. Your rates work the same until a room hits the cap. Co-op multiplies it by the number of players. Normal/Hard only, no cap in Greed.
Works in Greed and Greedier. Pulls from the Greed item pools (deeper floors unlock more pools: shop, then devil, then angel) with reduced rates so the economy stays intact.
Character-aware drops: - Keeper gets coins (heavily reduced in Greed so shopping still matters) - The Lost / Tainted Lost get Holy Cards and runes - Bethany / The Forgotten variants get soul and bone hearts - Tainted Judas leans black and soul hearts - Blue Baby gets soul hearts - Jacob & Esau and Tainted Lazarus can drop 2 items per kill, one for each half (they hold separate inventories). Optional, off by default.
Highly configurable: - Per-type drop rates (Normal / Champion / Boss) - Unlock filter: Off / Unlocked only / Seen only - Minimum quality + Quality Lock (pin drops to one exact tier) - Passives-only, actives-only, no Devil/Angel items - Force Pool, including a Chaos option (fully random item, ignores floor pools) - Local co-op: a separate drop per player (Fair or Chaos split) - Twins (Jacob & Esau) and Tainted Lazarus double drop toggle - Boss Rush limit: cap the ~20 bosses in Boss Rush to 1 drop total (or 1 per wave), instead of every single one rolling separately. Off by default. - Story bosses drop nothing by default: Isaac, ???, Satan, Mega Satan, Mother, Hush, Delirium, The Lamb, Dogma and The Beast never drop loot, and neither do the other bosses in The Void. Blue Womb drops nothing at all. Flip the toggle to turn it all back on. - Reset to Defaults button
MOVED OUT: the starting-loadout side of this mod (Starting Trinket Picker, Gulp keybind, Gulp Innate Trinket, Active to Pocket Active, Tainted Cain Push Mode and the Easy Greed/Greedier Counterfeit Penny) is no longer here. It became its own mod, Isaac QoL Kit, so this one stays what its name says: kill an enemy, get loot. Your old settings for those options are simply ignored, nothing else changes.
Requires: Mod Config Menu Pure REPENTOGON: optional (improves unlock filtering and character-item compatibility). Works fine without it.
Disable the original Enemy Loot Drop if you have it. Running both doubles everything. Safe to run alongside Isaac QoL Kit - the two mods don't overlap anymore.
Huge thanks to BackToTheBasement for the first video on this mod, and for the feedback that helped shape this update. Go check his channel: https://www.youtube.com/@BackToTheBasement_268
My first mod, expect bugs.
